_provenance: 28 lunar mansions (manāzil al-qamar), Arabic-rooted. Names/meanings/marking-stars verified vs al-Bīrūnī; Latin names = Picatrix/Agrippa corruptions kept visible. EQUAL-DIVISION bounds (360/28 = 12.857° from 0° Aries) are tropical & FIXED (non-precessing). Marking stars PRECESS — compute live via stars.py if star-based bounds wanted. NATURES: Latin = Picatrix/Agrippa (verbatim); Arabic = Abenragel-attested (al-Bīrūnī gives no fortune valence; al-Būnī Šams al-maʿārif pending Arabic-language recovery). The single fortunate/unfortunate binary is itself a Latin-mediated flattening — see DISPUTED.md.

_albuni_note: al-Būnī's rūḥāniyya scheme is a THREE-valence triad (ṣāliḥa/benefic, radīʾa/malefic, mumtazija/MIXED), NOT a binary — recovered by reading the Šams al-maʿārif Arabic EPUB (Shamela.org), via a polyglot Arabic-primary pass. CAVEAT: the printed Šams al-maʿārif is a late (17th-c.) pseudo-Būnī vulgate (Gardiner/Irwin) — vulgate-verified, not al-Būnī-the-man. KEY CORRECTION: on the 8 'inversions' al-Būnī sides with the LATIN on 3/4/24, with Abenragel on 18/26, gives a third reading on 8, and is SILENT on the M11 captive question — so the inversions are better read as Abenragel↔Picatrix (two electional traditions), NOT a clean 'Latin flattened the Arabic.' Three Arabic streams disagree: al-Bīrūnī (no valence), Abenragel (per-activity grid), al-Būnī (rūḥāniyya triad). See DISPUTED.md §M.
